displayName: Foot Locker API - Release Calendar, Size Availability, Prices in 13 Markets
description: Foot Locker API as structured JSON - the Foot Locker release calendar (launch date and time, retail price, size run, reservation windows, heat level) for the US, Canada and the UK as monitoring data; search footlocker.com or 12 country storefronts (Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand) or browse a category, a brand, the Sale list, Foot Locker Exclusives or promo-code-eligible items, 48 products per page with price, list price, percent off, the EU 30-day lowest price, rating and every colorway's price, filtered by brand, gender, color, price bucket, shoe size or any facet; read one product with per-size availability (yes / no to ship and to pick up, and how many stores show the size), colorways and launch info; find US Foot Locker stores and which nearby stores show a size as available; read US review text and shopper Q&A. 10 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
